item.title: a short note about pure functions
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
A quick write-up on pure functions, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Pure functions shows up across programming work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: thinking about pure functions
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Every few months pure functions bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Pure functions shows up across programming work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
